title: Credit Pricing Matrix — Variable-Rate Spread by Collateral Coverage, Farm Real Estate Loans
content:
When automatic debit is authorised on a FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage (Farm Real Estate Loans), the spread over the Association Variable Base Rate in the rate set that day follows the loan's collateral coverage.

**Collateral coverage** is the principal balance divided by the appraised value of the parcels still mortgaged (every parcel mortgaged to the loan less every parcel released from it), as a percentage rounded to 2 decimals.

**Matrix.** At or below 50 percent the spread is 0.10 percentage points; above 65 percent it is 0.50 percentage points; in between it is the product's variable-rate spread.

| Collateral coverage | Spread (percentage points) |
|---|---|
| 50.00 percent or less | 0.10 |
| 50.01 through 65.00 percent | the product's variable-rate spread |
| above 65.00 percent | 0.50 |

## Reading the parcel record (hypothetical loan)

| Parcel entry | Appraised value (USD) |
|---|---|
| Irrigated quarter, mortgaged | 640000 |
| Dryland tract, mortgaged | 460000 |
| Pasture parcel, mortgaged | 100000 |
| Pasture parcel, released on sale | 100000 |
| Value still mortgaged | 1100000 |

With a principal balance of USD 572000.00, coverage is 572000 divided by 1100000, that is 52.00 percent — the product's variable-rate spread applies. At a balance of USD 550000.00 coverage is exactly 50.00 percent and the spread is 0.10; at USD 715110.00 coverage is 65.01 percent and the spread is 0.50.
